div.div:
Keys: one 32-byte master key per mesh. Each node's key = HKDF(master, node ID). The gateway derives any node's key on demand; a captured device gives up only its own.
Nonce (never reused with one key): node ID[0:8] + counter. Unique per node for 4 billion frames.
